summary: Frontend-only E2E of SILAIGO Order Workflow Redesign, Customer Tracking & WhatsApp Automation. Most new UI wiring is intact and non-destructive: homepage TrackOrderSection widget renders with data-testid, admin login works, Orders page still loads (409 orders, no regressions), single-order modal opens and now shows the new [data-testid=order-status-stepper] 7-stage visual stepper ABOVE the old quick-facts grid while preserving Processing State / Order Status / Assign Stitching Agent selects, Pin-to-Top switch and Notify Customer (SMS) buttons. New [data-testid=tab-trigger-dispatch] Ready-to-Dispatch tab is present alongside Orders / Pickups / Cutting Queue (all 4 tabs render, dispatch-queue-view renders 'Nothing waiting for dispatch right now' since no live order is in READY_FOR_DISPATCH). Cutting Queue tab shows 11 [data-testid^=queue-start-btn-] buttons; clicking Start Cutting locally toggles to [data-testid=queue-advance-btn-...] as designed (state cleared via localStorage + reload afterwards; no prod mutation). WhatsApp opt-in [data-testid=whatsapp-optin-checkbox-form] renders on /admin/create-order, checked by default. HOWEVER, one real bug found: the TrackOrderSection Track submit button stays permanently disabled even after typing an Order ID (React state `orderId` is not updating from input onChange, so !orderId.trim() stays true and the button is unclickable) — this blocks end-users from ever submitting and therefore blocks the intended graceful-failure toast flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Track submit button [data-testid=track-order-submit] never becomes enabled — even after typing text into [data-testid=track-order-input] (verified via Playwright .fill() and .type() at ~50ms/char; DOM input.value = 'TEST999A' but is_disabled() = True). Because handleTrack ALSO short-circuits on `!orderId.trim()`, pressing Enter is a no-op too. Net effect: users can never submit an Order ID and never see the expected graceful failure message.

rca of the issue: TrackOrderSection: shadcn <Input value={orderId} onChange={...}/> renders and receives typed characters (input.value updates in DOM), but the <Button disabled={loading || !orderId.trim()}> never re-enables. That means the React `orderId` state is not being set — the onChange isn't firing, OR the component tree isn't hydrated. Given the console shows repeated `%s is an async Client Component. Only Server Components can be async at the moment. This error is often caused by accidentally adding 'use client' to a module that was originally...`, the most likely RCA is a hydration failure in the homepage's client bundle (one of the newly added client modules — TrackOrderSection or CustomerStatusStepper or a shared import — is being treated as an async Client Component). Under that failure, React handlers never bind; the DOM value comes from Playwright's synthetic input events but the state setter never runs. Mitigation: (a) audit new client files for any `export default async function Component()` — Client Components must be sync; if fetching, use useEffect+useState; (b) also fix the hard-coded localhost:3000 fetch which further contaminates the console; (c) as a defensive measure, gate the Track button only on `loading`, and validate trim() inside handleTrack so Enter/click still works even if state briefly lags.
